propositions: MCP server bridge tools fail with exit_code=2 because JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN environment variables are unset, despite operator-seeded SSM parameters existing out-of-band

Terraform has no declared resources for the three operator-seeded Jira credentials in ssm.tf, so terraform apply will collide with ParameterAlreadyExists; import blocks are required to adopt them into state without value overrides

JIRA_PROJECT environment variable must also be wired as a fourth parameter because access_check._resolve_probe_scope fails closed with missing_project when it is unset, and the probe reads environment only, not rebar.toml

Jira credentials must degrade softly (optional fetch, no abort, typed per-tool error) rather than fail closed, because they are outbound integration credentials not auth boundaries, and a failed fetch blocks all mcp deploys

The four variables must reach mcp containers via .env file only, never re-spelled as -e flags in mcp_run_new, because docker run does not interpolate the project .env and would clobber real values with blanks
